name: Voronoi Triangles 3D
desc: A faceted crystalline field of Voronoi cells extruded into fake-3D gem facets, each triangle flat-shaded by a slowly orbiting light while the cells breathe on the beat and the whole lattice re-cuts itself every section.

relief.doc: facet extrusion height — how sharply the gems pop out

hue.doc: base jewel hue (cells spread around it)

style.doc: render philosophy: gem = specular cut-crystal facets / lowpoly = matte desaturated terrain / wireframe = glowing facet-edge mesh, no fills (abstract) / stained = flat translucent cells with heavy black leading, no 3D

act.doc: multi-minute program: drift = calm orbiting light + gentle breathe / shatter = fast light, hard pops, jitter / grow = extrusion height swells and collapses across the section

seed.doc: site layout (folded with section index so the lattice re-cuts each section)
